Title: Local Models + OpenRouter Integration Foundation
Summary: PROVIDER-ADAPTER FOUNDATION for future LOCAL model runtimes and OpenRouter gateway routes, built provider-independently on the existing AI-routing architecture. The generic local abstraction is NOT 'Ollama == local models': a runtime is expressed by DB-M14 ProviderType/GatewayType vocabulary + the DB-M23 ApiStyle (OPENAI_COMPATIBLE / OLLAMA_COMPATIBLE / ANTHROPIC_COMPATIBLE / OPENROUTER / GENERIC), never a hard-coded runtime name in shared logic. LocalProviderConfiguration v1 (Locality forced LOCAL; SecretReference/ConfigurationKey are NAMES, never values). OpenRouter is a GATEWAY, never a model: route decomposition keeps gateway identity distinct from model identity (ProviderId=openrouter, ModelId=or:<route>, ProviderModelId=full route id, UnderlyingModelId=model part after the last '/', ':variant' stripped). Shared common layer (AdapterContracts/AdapterRequest/AdapterResponse/AdapterExecutionGate) owns request normalization (DB-M14 reasoning NONE/LOW/MEDIUM/HIGH/MAX -> provider param; unsupported reported UNSUPPORTED, never silently dropped), usage normalization (Input/CachedInput/CacheWrite/Output/Reasoning/Total/ProviderReportedCost; no fabricated usage; TotalTokens only when input+output known), response normalization (ProviderResponse v1 fixed field list), error normalization (DB-M23 categories -> DB-M20 vocabulary; PROVIDER_UNAVAILABLE->PROVIDER_AVAILABILITY, others identity; NO provider-specific failure logic in DB-M20), pricing integration (DB-M15 Get-AiPriceAt READ-ONLY; CONFIGURED/FREE/LOCAL_COST_UNKNOWN/PRICE_UNKNOWN; zero provider token price is NEVER zero operational cost; LOCAL != FREE automatically), health integration (DB-M22 evidence contract READ-ONLY; offline/model-not-loaded->UNAVAILABLE+PASSIVE_FAILURE+PROVIDER_AVAILABILITY, disabled->DISABLED+CONFIGURATION, auth->AUTH_ERROR+AUTHENTICATION, rate-limit->RATE_LIMITED+RATE_LIMIT; NEVER MODEL_QUALITY; no polling loops), budget integration (DB-M21 decisions READ-ONLY; allowed set ALLOW/ALLOW_WITH_WARNING/NO_APPLICABLE_BUDGET), router integration (DB-M19 RoutingDecisionEvidence READ-ONLY; adapter cannot rewrite a rejected routing decision). Execution gate: AUTO->AUTO_EXECUTION_PROHIBITED, non-eligible->ROUTING_NOT_ELIGIBLE, budget block->BUDGET_BLOCK, route unavailable->HEALTH_BLOCK; AUTO_EXECUTION_ENABLED=FALSE; MANUAL preserved; ASSISTED represented. DRY_RUN returns DRY_RUN_READY (native request shape + redacted headers, NoSend, NetworkCalls=0, PaidApiCalls=0). Secret protection: no secret values stored; Test-DbM23SecretLeak scans free text and rejects secret-like values; ConvertTo-DbM23RedactedValue/Headers keep Bearer scheme, redact the credential; a fake secret injected via the referenced env var never appears in the serialized DRY_RUN artifact. NO provider/model executed, 0 network calls, 0 paid API calls.
